prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Companion Controls", "Learn how to interact with, hide, or summon your desktop pet anytime using desktop hotkeys and tray options.", "Control Shortcuts", "Interactive Mascot Preview"]
1: ["Your pet style options will be calibrated next before finalized."]
2: ["Secure Your Pet Account & Progress", "Linking your account ensures your desktop pet, items, and settings are saved permanently across sessions.", "Your pet data is automatically backed up once signed in."]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Environment", "Checking screen overlay permissions, taskbar integration, and animation assets...", "Screen Overlay Permission", "Rendering Asset Loader"]
4: ["Choose Your Companion Archetype", "Compare companion behaviors and interaction modes side-by-side."]
5: ["Next: Quick Controls"]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name your desktop companion and issue its official adoption badge.", "Companion Name", "Certified Companion"]
7: ["Assembling Your Desktop Companion", "We are loading your pet's animations and desktop behaviors. You can minimize this window anytime."]
8: ["Don't worry—you can unlock or switch paths anytime after onboarding from your settings."]
9: ["Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!", "Check your desktop screen to see your new pet in action.", "Complete Setup"]
